Options

Save Your Adventure

Download your progress, then bring it along to another device.

🌎 Choose Locations

Choose extra locations for Learn and compatible quizzes. Changing the pool starts a new question. Statehood Timeline always uses U.S. states.

Optional geography packs

Population Showdowns compare the same reference year. Expanded Size Showdowns compare land area. UM is one collective entry, with no common capital or comparable Showdown total.

★ Card Facts

Choose up to four fact groups for the back of your card. All other facts appear in More Facts. City lists and landmarks always live there. Flags and capital stars are always visible where applicable and don’t use a fact slot. Facts that do not apply to a location are omitted.

Image/Data Credits & methods

⚙ Game settings & offline play

When enabled, check for and apply ready updates before play. Offline or slow checks never stop the game.

Scoring: 100 points per correct answer, plus a streak bonus that grows by 10 for each consecutive correct answer, up to +100. Wrong answers earn 0 and reset the streak; earned points stay yours.

Preparing offline play…

On iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: your browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen. Load the game online once before playing offline. Saves stay on this device; use Export to back them up.

Replace your progress?

Your current journal will be replaced. Export it first if you want to keep a copy.
